name: Ball Toss on Single Leg

instructions.description: Stand on one leg holding a light medicine ball or soft ball at chest height.
Maintain balance as you toss the ball gently upward or to a wall and catch it again.
Keep the standing knee soft and your eyes tracking the ball.
Lower the other foot to rest, then repeat on the opposite side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use light controlled throws that do not disturb posture excessively.

variations.variationDescription: Adds an upper-limb task and visual challenge to the basic single-leg hold.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform from a stable double-leg stance to regress the challenge.

commentsNotes: Use a light ball and a safe throwing distance.
